delivery_target: retype_region_etcb_at or any future consumer of retype_etcb_at_helper where tcb_state is not known
new_lemma:
lemma retype_etcb_at_helper_no_inactive: "\<lbrakk>etcb_at' P t ekh; valid_etcbs_2 ekh kh; d \<noteq> apiobject_type.Untyped;
        foldr (\<lambda>p kh. kh(p \<mapsto> default_object d dev c))
         ptrs
         kh t =
        Some (TCB tcb)\<rbrakk>
       \<Longrightarrow> etcb_at' P t
           ((foldr (\<lambda>p ekh. ekh(p := default_ext d cdom))
             ptrs)
             ekh)"
  apply (induct ptrs)
  apply simp
  apply (case_tac d)
  apply (clarsimp split: if_split_asm simp: default_tcb_def default_object_def default_ext_def etcb_at'_def)+
  done
rationale: The proof of retype_etcb_at_helper (L68-72) never references tcb_state: the induction and clarsimp only inspect d and etcb_at'. The tcb_state ≠ Inactive conjunct is therefore not consumed by the proof.
strengthening_claim: (etcb_at' P t ekh ∧ valid_etcbs_2 ekh kh ∧ d ≠ Untyped ∧ foldr...t = Some(TCB tcb)) ==> (etcb_at' P t ekh ∧ valid_etcbs_2 ekh kh ∧ d ≠ Untyped ∧ foldr...t = Some(TCB tcb) ∧ tcb_state tcb ≠ Inactive)
